answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 158520 Country: India Title: What if someone misses years of prayers, including during Ramadan fasts, does he have to make all prayers and all Ramadan fasts? Question: What if someone misses years of prayers, including during Ramadan fasts, does he have to make all prayers and all Ramadan fasts? Answer ID: 158520 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 379/330/SD=4/1439) Yes, it is mandatory to make qaza of all the fardh or wajib ( witr ) prayers and all the fardh fasts which you missed after calculating them; otherwise it shall remain due on you. It is not enough to make taubah and pay fidyah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
